title: In viaggio: il treno
summary: Train travel vocabulary — Trenitalia, regionale vs alta velocità, il binario, timbrare il biglietto

blocks.title: The Italian train ritual
blocks.body: Italian trains come in two main flavors: the **regionale** (cheap, stops everywhere, no assigned seat) and the **alta velocità** (Frecciarossa, Italo — fast, assigned seat). One crucial rule: on the regionale you must **timbrare il biglietto** (validate the ticket) before boarding, or you risk a fine.
blocks.callout: No validation on the regionale = trouble with the conductor.

blocks.prompt: You board a regionale without validating your ticket. What do you risk?
blocks.explain: On the regionale, validation is mandatory — forgetting it can cost you a fine (*una multa*).

blocks.prompt: Which question do you ask to find the right platform?
options: Da che binario parte il treno per Roma?
blocks.explain: *Da che binario parte…?* is the question for the platform.

pairs.left: *il regionale* — slow, stops everywhere, cheap, no assigned seat, must be validated
pairs.right: *l'alta velocità* — fast, assigned seat, no validation needed
pairs.note: The type of train changes the rules — always check before boarding.

blocks.scene: At Bologna Centrale, Marco helps You find the right platform

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.en: So, do you have the ticket?

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Sì, ma non ho ancora timbrato.
lines.en: Yes, but I haven't validated it yet.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Meglio timbrarlo subito! Il binario è il sette.
lines.en: Better validate it right away! The platform is seven.
lines.spotlight: timbrare — the regionale rule, never skip it.

lines.speaker: You
lines.en: Thanks! It's a regional train, right?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Sì, per il regionale devi sempre timbrare. Con l'alta velocità no.
lines.en: Yes, for the regional you always have to validate. Not with the high-speed train.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.nl: Buon viaggio! Mi scrivi quando arrivi?
lines.en: Have a good trip! Will you text me when you arrive?
